title: tests/agent setup.sh PTY helper run_interactive: return only after child is reaped and PTY reaches EOF
answers: Why does the setup.sh E2E test sometimes miss the final 'Setup complete' line in its output?
How do I send scripted responses to an interactive setup script in the agent tests?
Where is the PTY exit and EOF handling for the setup script tests?
Why does the interactive setup test fail with 'Interactive process did not finish'?
body:
Path: tests/agent/setup_sh_test_utils.py:run_interactive runs an interactive setup script under a pseudo-terminal in tests, writes scripted responses to the PTY, collects output, and returns (exit code, decoded transcript) for tests/agent/test_setup_sh_e2e.py.
Rule: Track child reaping (os.waitpid with WNOHANG) and PTY read EOF as two independent flags, and return only when both are true. An empty os.read or Linux EIO counts as EOF; other OSError values are re-raised. Once EOF is set, stop selecting on the closed fd and keep polling only for the child.
Symptom: The transcript was truncated, so the final buffered lines such as 'Setup complete' were missing from the captured output even though the script exited successfully, making output assertions flaky.
Constraints: Test helper only, not product code. The 10-second deadline still applies and now fails with 'did not finish'. The EIO-as-EOF mapping is the Linux PTY behavior described in the PR; the fd is closed in the finally block and the child is killed if it was not reaped.
applies: Applies to the PTY-driven setup.sh test helper in tests/agent; does not cover other subprocess or pipe-based test helpers.
